en: Ala al-Din Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qushji
ar: علاء الدين علي بن محمد القوشجي

description.tr: Semerkand ile İstanbul bilimsel gelenekleri arasında köprü — Uluğ Bey'in Rasathanesi'ni yönetti, sonra Timurlu astronomik bilgisini Osmanlı sarayına getirdi. Kopernik'ten on yıllar önce Dünya'nın dönüşünü savundu || Ali Kuşçu, Timurlu'dan Osmanlı bilim dünyasına kritik bilgi transferini temsil eder. Semerkand Rasathanesi'nde yetişti, Meraga-Semerkand astronomi geleneğini miras alıp İstanbul'a getirdi. || [Tarih notu] Ragep (2001, 2007), Ali Kuşçu'dan Kopernik'e İtalyan aracılar yoluyla olası aktarım zincirini araştırdı.
description.en: Bridge between Samarkand and Istanbul scientific traditions — directed Ulugh Beg's Observatory, then brought Timurid astronomical knowledge to the Ottoman court. Argued for Earth's rotation decades before Copernicus || Ali Qushji represents the critical knowledge transfer from the Timurid to Ottoman scientific worlds. Trained at the Samarkand Observatory, he inherited the Maragha-Samarkand astronomical tradition (Tusi couple, non-Ptolemaic models) and brought it to Istanbul. His argument that Earth's rotation cannot be disproved by physics (only by astronomy) is strikingly similar to Copernicus's reasoning — raising questions about possible transmission. || [Historiographical note] Ragep (2001, 2007) explored the possible transmission chain from Ali Qushji to Copernicus via Italian intermediaries. Fazlıoğlu (2014) documented Qushji's institutional impact on Ottoman scientific education.
description.ar: جسر بين تقاليد سمرقند وإسطنبول العلمية — أدار مرصد أولوغ بك || علي قوشجي يمثل نقل المعرفة الحرج من العالم العلمي التيموري إلى العثماني. حجته بأن دوران الأرض لا يمكن دحضه بالفيزياء تشابه تفكير كوبرنيكوس
